title: Detailed lightning bolt
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='bolt' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#FFFDE0'/>
      <stop offset='0.3' stop-color='#FFE84D'/>
      <stop offset='0.6' stop-color='#FFC107'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#FF9800'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='core' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#FFFFFF'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#FFF59D'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='glow' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#FFD54F' stop-opacity='0.55'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#FF8F00' stop-opacity='0.15'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- soft outer glow -->
  <path d='M58 2 L36 40 L50 40 L30 70 L46 70 L22 100 L52 62 L38 62 L58 34 L46 34 Z'
        fill='#FFCE33' opacity='0.35'/>
  <path d='M56 6 L38 44 L51 44 L33 72 L48 72 L26 96 L54 66 L42 66 L60 38 L49 38 Z'
        fill='#FFB300' opacity='0.4'/>

  <!-- main bolt body -->
  <path d='M60 0 L34 42 L50 42 L28 76 L46 76 L20 100 L54 60 L38 60 L58 30 L44 30 Z'
        fill='url(#bolt)'/>

  <!-- bright inner core -->
  <path d='M56 10 L40 44 L52 44 L36 70 L50 70 L32 92 L50 64 L40 64 L56 36 L47 36 Z'
        fill='url(#core)'/>

  <!-- highlight streak along the left side -->
  <path d='M56 10 L42 40 L48 40 L38 62 L43 62 L34 82 L46 58 L40 58 L52 32 L46 32 Z'
        fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.75'/>

  <!-- secondary forked branch, upper right -->
  <path d='M58 30 L72 22 L68 32 L78 28 L66 42 L72 34 L62 46 L68 40 L60 48 Z'
        fill='#FFD54F' opacity='0.9'/>
  <path d='M60 32 L70 25 L67 32 L74 29 L65 38 L69 33 L62 42 Z'
        fill='#FFF9C4' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- secondary forked branch, lower left -->
  <path d='M46 76 L32 84 L38 76 L26 86 L36 78 L28 92 L42 80 L38 86 L50 76 Z'
        fill='#FFCA28' opacity='0.9'/>
  <path d='M47 77 L36 83 L40 78 L31 86 L38 81 L33 89 L44 80 Z'
        fill='#FFF176' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- small spark details -->
  <circle cx='62' cy='52' r='2.5' fill='#FFFDE7'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='52' r='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='56' r='2' fill='#FFE082'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='56' r='0.9' fill='#FFFFF0'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='24' r='1.8' fill='#FFF9C4' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='78' r='1.5' fill='#FFD54F' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- tiny trailing sparks -->
  <path d='M68 20 L71 17 L70 21 Z' fill='#FFE082'/>
  <path d='M24 90 L20 94 L23 88 Z' fill='#FFCA28' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
